Dear Sir/Madam,

Kinwarden is acting on behalf of the family of [PERSON_1] (age 62), who was admitted to Siam Riverside International Hospital this morning with [MEDICAL_1]. The attending [MEDICAL_9] has indicated that he will need an [MEDICAL_4], and possibly a [MEDICAL_7]. His attendant, [PERSON_2], is with him at the hospital.

We will be handling the hospital payments on the family's behalf. To do this properly and to avoid any delay for the patient, we would be grateful if you could send us, in a single reply:

1. A written cost estimate or fee statement covering the [MEDICAL_4] and the possible [MEDICAL_7], including the expected length of stay and any likely additional charges.
2. The deposit or advance payment you require before treatment, and the deadline by which it must reach you.
3. Your bank details for remittance, on official hospital letterhead (account name, account number, bank name and address, SWIFT/BIC), together with the bank address for the wire.
4. The patient's hospital number (HN), which we understand your bank requires as the payment reference, plus any other reference you need quoted.
5. Confirmation of whether payment at the hospital desk by Visa debit card is possible, and any surcharge that would apply.

Once we have the estimate and your verified bank details, we will arrange the transfer and send you the remittance confirmation. Please note that we can only remit funds to bank details supplied by the hospital itself on its own documentation; we cannot act on details sent by any other party.

Thank you for your help at what is a worrying time for the family.

Kind regards,
Kinwarden, on behalf of the family of [PERSON_1]
